n-k-k3-01.title: Impelasonto ekhaya?
n-k-k3-01.goal: Qhathanisa isimangalo esiqinile somfundi osebenza naye nedayari emfushane, khetha igama lobuningi elisekelwa ubufakazi, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani 'always' kudlula kakhulu.
n-k-k3-01.material:
Umfundi osebenza naye uthi: "세진은 주말에 항상 집에 있어요." Ufunda idayari yempelasonto ka-세진 amasonto amane:

1주 토요일: 집에서 쉬었어요.
1주 일요일: 집에서 책을 읽었어요.
2주 토요일: 친구랑 극장에서 영화를 봤어요.
2주 일요일: 집에서 쉬었어요.
3주 토요일: 집에서 게임을 했어요.
3주 일요일: 집에서 청소를 했어요.
4주 토요일: 집에서 쉬었어요.
4주 일요일: 공원에서 자전거를 탔어요.
n-k-k3-01.prereq.1: Uyazi i-항상 (njalo) ne-아니에요 (akuyona); amanye amagama obuningi (보통, 가끔, 거의) achazwa ezinkombeni nasencazelweni
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.prompt: Yimuphi umusho mayelana no-세진 osekelwa kangcono idayari yonke?
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bala ukuthi bangaki phakathi kwezinsuku zempelasonto ezi-8 abachithe ekhaya nokuthi bangaki abangazange.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.hint.1: Fanisa izinombolo zakho ezimbili namagama: 항상 = njalo, 보통 = ngokuvamile, 가끔 = ngezikhathi ezithile, 거의 없어요 = cishe akunjalo.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.a: Izinsuku ezimbili kweziyisishiyagalombili zachithwa ngaphandle (isinema nepaki), ngakho 'always' idlula idayari.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.b: Izinsuku eziyisithupha kweziyisishiyagalombili zazisekhaya, ngakho 'akasekho ekhaya' kuphambene nalokho idayari ekukhombisayo.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.d: I-'가끔' isho kuphela ngezikhathi ezithile. Idayari ikhombisa ekhaya ezinsukwini eziningi, okungaphezu kwe-'ngezikhathi ezithile'.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.e: I-'거의 없어요' isho cishe akekho ekhaya, okuphambene nezinsuku eziyisithupha kweziyisishiyagalombili ekhaya.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.explain: Bala izinsuku: 6 kwezinsuku zempelasonto ezi-8 zazisekhaya, 2 zazingekho. Igama elithi 'ngokuvamile' (보통) liyafaneleka; igama elithi 'njalo' (항상) liqine kakhulu, futhi 'ngezikhathi ezithile' noma 'cishe akunjalo' libuthaka kakhulu.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.prompt: Umfundi osebenza naye uthi '세진은 주말에 항상 집에 있어요.' Yiziphi izinto zedayari ezikhombisa ukuthi lesi simangalo asiyona iqiniso? Khetha zonke ezisebenzayo.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.hint.0: Isimangalo sikhuluma ngoZONKE izinsuku zempelasonto. Yiluphi uhlobo losuku olungaluphula: olufanelana nesimangalo noma olungafaneleki?
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kokuthunyelwe ngakunye, nquma: kufanelana nesimangalo noma kuyaluphula?
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.r.a: Lolu suku lwalusekhaya, ngakho luvumelana nesimangalo. Alukwazi ukukhombisa ukuthi isimangalo asilungile.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.r.c: Lolu suku lwalusekhaya nalo, ngakho luvumelana nesimangalo.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.explain: Isimangalo esine-'always' siphulwa usuku olulodwa olungafaneleki. Izinsuku ezichithwe ekhaya zivumelana nesimangalo kuphela; azikwazi ukusifakazela, ngoba isimangalo sikhuluma ngazo zonke izinsuku.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.acc.0: Isibonelo esiphikisayo esisodwa sesanele ukuphula i-'항상'; esesibili, 4주 일요일, sikhombisa ukuthi kwakungesona isenzakalo esisodwa.
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.prompt: Phendula umfundi osebenza naye ngesiKorea (inkulumo enenhlonipho nge--요). Sho ukuthi i-'항상' ayilungile, bese unikeza usuku olulodwa lwedayari njengobufakazi.
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngengxenye ethi 'hhayi njalo', bese wengeza into eyodwa yedayari.
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.hint.1: Sho ukuthi 세진 wayekuphi ngalolo suku, usebenzisa i--에서.
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngiqambe usuku oluthile noma indawo yedayari?
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe impendulo yami inobungane futhi ayiqinile?
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Iqamba igama elingcono futhi inikeza ubufakazi.

n-k-k3-02.title: Uhlelo luka-하나 nesaziso somtapo wezincwadi
n-k-k3-02.topic: Ukungqubuzana kwesikhathi nendawo phakathi kohlelo nesaziso
n-k-k3-02.goal: Hlola uhlelo lwesonto lomngane uma luqhathaniswa nesaziso, uthole umugqa owodwa ophikisanayo, usho ukuthi uhlobo luni lokungqubuzana, bese ulungisa uhlelo.
n-k-k3-02.material:
하나 uyakuthumelela uhlelo lwakhe lwalesi sonto. Umtapo wezincwadi wesikole uthumele lesi saziso:

[학교 도서관 안내]
- 문을 열어요: 화요일~일요일, 오전 9시~오후 6시
- 월요일은 쉬어요.
- 책은 2주 동안 빌릴 수 있어요.
n-k-k3-02.prereq.1: Uyazi izinsuku zesonto ne-오전/오후 + inombolo + 시
n-k-k3-02.s.s1.prompt: Uhlelo luka-하나 lwalesi sonto alufanelani nesaziso somtapo wezincwadi emugqeni owodwa. Khetha lowo mugqa.
n-k-k3-02.s.s1.hint.0: Qala uhlele izinsuku namahora lapho umtapo wezincwadi uvuliwe, usebenzisa isaziso kuphela.
n-k-k3-02.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola wonke umugqa okhuluma ngomtapo wezincwadi: ingabe usuku NEHORA kuyafanelana nohlu lwakho?
n-k-k3-02.s.s1.explain: Umugqa wesi-2 uthi umtapo wezincwadi ngoMsombuluko, kodwa isaziso sithi umtapo wezincwadi uvaliwe ngoMsombuluko. Umugqa wesi-5 (iSonto, 5 p.m.) ulungile ngoba umtapo wezincwadi uvuliwe ngeSonto kuze kube ngu-6 p.m.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qhathanisa usuku emugqeni nesaziso, bese uqhathanisa ihora.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.hint.1: Sho ukuthi yiliphi phakathi kwamabili (usuku, ihora), uma lisekhona, elingafanelani nesaziso.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.a: 하나 uhlela ukuya ngaphambi kokuvulwa komtapo wezincwadi.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.r.a: Ihora lokuvula ngu-9 a.m., ngakho u-10 a.m. uphakathi namahora okuvula; inkinga yimininingwane enye.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.b: 하나 uhlela ukuya ngosuku lapho uhlelo lwakhe lungqubuzana nomunye umugqa.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.r.b: Akukho omunye umugqa wohlelo lwakhe owela ngalolo suku, ngakho lokhu akuyona inkinga.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.c: 하나 uhlela ukuya ngesikhathi esingemuva kokuvalwa komtapo wezincwadi.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.r.c: Ihora (10 a.m.) liphakathi namahora okuvula; inkinga yimininingwane enye.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.d: 하나 uhlela ukuya ngosuku lapho umtapo wezincwadi uvaliwe.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.explain: Ihora lilungile, kodwa usuku oluvaliwe lwenza lonke uhambo lungenzeki. Ukuhlola uhlelo ngesaziso kusho ukuhlola yonke imininingwane (usuku, ihora, indawo), futhi imininingwane eyodwa yanele ukuyiphula.
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.prompt: Bhala kabusha umugqa ongalungile ngesiKorea (inkulumo enenhlonipho) ukuze uhlelo lusebenze. Gcina injongo (ukuboleka izincwadi), kodwa shintsha usuku noma isikhathi.
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.hint.0: Khetha usuku ezinsukwini zesaziso ezivuliwe; bese ukhetha ihora phakathi kokuvula nokuvala.
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.hint.1: Gcina iphethini usuku + isikhathi: indawo + into + isenzo, njengakweminye imigqa.
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usuku olusha luluso umtapo wezincwadi uvuliwe ngalo?
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe isikhathi sami esisha sifanelana namahora okuvula (9 a.m. kuya ku-6 p.m.)?
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe usuku olusha lungqubuzana nomunye umugqa kuhlelo luka-하나?

n-k-k3-03.title: Usuku lwefilimu olunemikhawulo
n-k-k3-03.goal: Guqula umbhalo womngane onemikhawulo eminingi (izinsuku ezingekho, ihora lokuqala, isikhathi sokuphela esimisiwe) ube yizinhlelo ezivumelekile, uthole ngaphezu kowodwa, bese ubika owodwa ngesiKorea.
n-k-k3-03.material:
지호 uyakuthumelela umbhalo:

"이번 주 평일에 같이 영화를 봐요! 월요일이랑 수요일에는 학원이 있어서 안 돼요. 다른 날은 오후 3시 이후에 시간이 있어요. 영화는 두 시간이에요. 오후 6시까지는 끝나야 해요."
n-k-k3-03.thinking.0: Isimo esifihlekile: ubude befilimu bushintsha isikhathi sokuqala
n-k-k3-03.prereq.1: Uyazi izinsuku zokusebenza ne-오후 + inombolo + 시
n-k-k3-03.prereq.2: Uhlangane ne--까지 (ngaphambi, kuze kube), 이후 (ngemuva) ne-전에 (ngaphambi); zichazwa ezinkombeni
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.prompt: Ifilimu iphatha amahora ama-2 futhi kumele iphele ngo-6 p.m. Yisiphi isikhathi sokuqala SAMUVA esisebenzayo?
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.hint.0: Thatha ihora lesi-6 bese ukhipha ubude befilimu.
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola impendulo yakho ngokwengeza amahora ama-2 kuyo. Umphumela ungu-6 noma ngaphambili?
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.r.b: Leso yisikhathi ifilimu okumele iphele ngaso, hhayi isikhathi engaqala ngaso.
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.r.c: Ukuqala ngo-5 p.m. kusho ukuthi ifilimu iphela ngo-7 p.m., okungemuva kwesi-6.
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.r.d: 3 p.m. iyasebenza, kodwa yisikhathi sokuqala sokuqala umngane wakho akuvumelayo, hhayi samuva.
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.explain: Ukuqala + amahora ama-2 kumele kube ngu-6 noma ngaphambili, ngakho ukuqala ngu-4 ngokuphakeme kakhulu. Kanye ne-'ngemuva kwe-3 p.m.' ngu-3 no-4 kuphela abangenzeka.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.prompt: Thola izinhlelo ezi-3 ezifanelana nazo zonke izimo zomlayezo ka-지호, ngasinye ngosuku olwehlukile noma ngesikhathi esihlukile. d = inombolo yosuku (월=1, 화=2, 수=3, 목=4, 금=5); h = ihora ifilimu eqala ngalo, ntambama (3 isho 3 p.m.).
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.0: 이후 = ngemuva (kubalwa kusuka) kuleso sikhathi; -까지 = kuze kube / ngaphambi kwaleso sikhathi.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala umlayezo ngamazwi akho njengemithetho ehlukene: yiziphi izinsuku ezingekho, kusukela ehoreni elingakanani, nokuthi ifilimu iphela ngehora lini.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.2: Yenza izinsuku kuqala: sika 월 ne-수. Bese uzama ihora ngalinye lokuqala bese wengeza ama-2.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.3: Uma esinye sezinhlelo zakho siliwa, funda umlayezo ongaphansi kwethebula: usho ukuthi muphi umthetho ohlulekile.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.fail.c0: Sebenzisa inombolo yosuku ephelele nehora eliphelele.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.fail.c1: 지호 ufuna usuku lwesonto, ngakho u-d ungu-1 kuya ku-5.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.fail.c3: 지호 ukhululekile kuphela kusukela ngo-3 p.m.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Ifilimu yamahora angu-2 eqala kamuva kanje iphela ngemuva kuka-6 p.m.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.explain: Izinsuku zingaba ngu-화, 목 noma 금, futhi ukuqala kungaba ngu-3 noma 4 p.m., ngakho kunezinhlelo ezingu-6. Umlayezo unikeza imikhawulo, hhayi isikhathi esisodwa esiqondile.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha INHLELO EYODWA yakho uthumele ku-지호 umbhalo omfushane wesiKorea (-요 enenhlonipho) onosuku, isikhathi sokuqala nefilimu.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sebenzisa uhlelo olulodwa olungenhla: yiluphi usuku nehora?
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Sho usuku, bese isikhathi, bese ifilimu, uphethe nge--요.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Usuku nehora lami kuhambisana nohlelo olulodwa engilwakhile?
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Imithetho ka-지호 izogcinwa uma ethi yebo?

n-k-k3-04.title: Ingabe u-민수 uyeza ku-picnic?
n-k-k3-04.goal: Buyekeza isahlulelo sokuthi umfundi oqoqene naye uyeza yini njengoba imilayezo emisha ifika, qaphela amagama okuqagela, bese ubika izindaba ngenani elifanele lokuqiniseka.
n-k-k3-04.material: Uqoqa amagama e-picnic yekilasi ngoMgqibelo futhi udinga ukwazi ukuthi uthenge ukudla okungakanani. Uyazibuza ukuthi u-민수 uyeza yini. Imilayezo ifika ngokukodwa.
n-k-k3-04.thinking.1: Ubani okushilo (ukuqagela komngane noma umuntu ngokwakhe)
n-k-k3-04.thinking.2: Ukushintsha isiphetho lapho kuza ulwazi olusha
n-k-k3-04.prereq.1: Usuhlangane no-아마 (cishe) kanye no--ㄹ 것 같아요 (kubonakala); kuchazwe emaphuzwini
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.prompt: Funda umlayezo ngamunye ngokulandelana, khetha ukufunda okubonakala kunamathuba amaningi, bese uqhubeka.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.hint.1: Qaphela ukuthi ubani okhulumayo emlayezweni ngamunye, nokuthi yimaphi amagama athambisa umusho (아마, -ㄹ 것 같아요).
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: 지아 uqiniseke kangakanani ukuthi u-민수 uzofika ngoMgqibelo?
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.after: U-아마 umaka ukuqagela. Kule ndawo 'cishe uyeza' ukufunda okunengqondo, hhayi 'ngokuqinisekile uyeza'.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: U-'아마' usho 'cishe'. Umkhulumi oqinisekile ngokuphelele ngeke adinge lona.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Akukho lutho emshweni oluthi ngeke eze; u-'올 거예요' ukhomba ekufikeni.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ucabanga ukuthi cishe uzofika, kodwa akaqiniseki.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ukhuluma ngaye njengomuntu amaziyo; umusho umayelana nokuthi uyeza yini.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Manje u-민수 ngokwakhe uyakhuluma. Isithombe sibukeka kanjani?
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.after: U--ㄹ 것 같아요 no-아직 몰라요 bakhombisa umbuzo ovulekile. Lokho umuntu akusho ngokwakhe kubalulekile kunokuqagela komngane.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Akunqunyiwe: angase abe nokuvakashela esibhedlela, ngakho angase angakwazi ukufika.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Cishe uzofika, ngoba 지아 washo kanjalo.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Manje umuntu ngokwakhe uthi akaqiniseki, ngakho ukuqagela kuka-지아 kunesisindo esincane.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: U-'갈 것 같아요' ukhuluma ngokuvakasha okungenzeka esikhathini esizayo, hhayi okwenzeke kakade.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: U-'아직 몰라요' usho ukuthi akanqumanga, ngakho awukwazi ukusho ukuthi ngeke eze.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ungasho ini manje lapho uhlela i-picnic?
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Umlayezo omusha ushintsha ukuqagela okudala: ukufika manje kucacile kakhulu, kuyilapho u-'ukuphuza kancane' kusenjalo ukuqagela (-ㄹ 것 같아요).
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: U-민수 cishe ngeke akwazi ukufika ngenxa yesibhedlela.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ukuvakashela esibhedlela sekuphelile (다녀왔어요), futhi usho ukuthi angafika.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Usho ukuthi uzophuza kancane, ngakho akufanele uhlele ngesikhathi.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Manje usho ngokucacile ukuthi angahamba ngoMgqibelo; umbuzo ovulekile wayizolo usuphenduliwe.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: U-민수 angafika ngoMgqibelo, cishe ephuza kancane.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.reflect: Umbono wakho ngo-민수 washintsha nomlayezo ngamunye. Ukuqagela komngane (아마) kwathathelwa indawo amagama akhe ngokwakhe angaqinisekile, bese amagama akhe ngokwakhe acacile kakhulu. Amagama afana no-아마 no--ㄹ 것 같아요 amaka ukuqagela, futhi umlayezo omusha kakhulu ovela kumuntu ngokwakhe wumthombo omuhle kakhulu.
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.prompt: Yimaphi amabinzana alemilayezo emithathu akhombisa ukuthi umkhulumi akaqiniseki ngokuphelele? Khetha zonke ezisebenzayo.
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.hint.0: Kubinzana ngalinye buza: umkhulumi ubika into eyenzekile, noma uqagela ngento engase yenzeke?
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.hint.1: Zama ukushintsha ibinzana ngo-'ngokuqinisekile'. Umusho usalunga?
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.r.b: Lesi sitatimende esilula sento esivele senzekile, ngakho liyiqiniso, hhayi ukuqagela.
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.explain: U-아마 usho cishe, u--ㄹ 것 같아요 usho 'kubonakala ukuthi', no-아직 몰라요 usho 'angikazi okwamanje'. Isitatimende sesikhathi esedlule esifana no-다녀왔어요 sibika iqiniso.
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.prompt: Bhala izindaba engxoxweni yeqembu le-picnic ngesiKorea (inkulumo enenhlonipho): sho ukuthi u-민수 uyeza, futhi umake into eyodwa esengukuqagela kuphela.
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala imisho emibili emifushane: owodwa walokho okucacile, nowodwa walokho okungacacile.
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.hint.1: Engxenyeni engacacile, sebenzisa igama noma ukuphela osukuhlangane nakho emilayezweni.
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngigcine ingxenye ethi 'ukuphuza kancane' njengokuqagela hhayi njengeqiniso?
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Iqembu lingazi ukuthi libale abantu abangaki?

n-k-k3-05.title: 하준 usho ubani ngo-'저도요'?
n-k-k3-05.topic: Ubani ushilo ini: impendulo encike emugqeni wangaphambili
n-k-k3-05.goal: Thola ukuthi 'nami futhi' emfushane ibhekisela kubani nasekuthini engxoxweni yeqembu, nquma ukuthi yiziphi izinto ezisalahlekile esinqumweni seqembu, bese ubuza ngolunye lazo.
n-k-k3-05.material:
Abangane abathathu bakhetha isidlo sasemini engxoxweni yeqembu. I-비빔밥 yesitolo ngokuvamile iza ne-sauce ebabayo yepelepele ebomvu (고추장).

지아: 저는 비빔밥을 먹을래요.
하준: 저도 비빔밥이 좋아요.
서윤: 저는 매운 음식을 못 먹어요.
하준: 저도요.
n-k-k3-05.thinking.0: Ubani ushilo ini, nokuthi impendulo ibhekisela kuphi
n-k-k3-05.prereq.2: Uyazi u-맵다 (ababayo) efomini elithi 매운 / 안 매워요
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.prompt: Funda ingxoxo. Emugqeni wokugcina, 하준 usho ini ngo-'저도요'?
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.hint.0: Thola umugqa ngokuqondile ngenhla kwa-'저도요'. Yilokho avuma nakho.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.r.a: U-'저도요' uphendula umugqa ongaphambi ngqo. Lowo mugqa ungowa-서윤, hhayi owa-지아.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.o.b: Naye ufuna ukudla isidlo sasemini no-서윤.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.r.b: Umugqa wangaphambilini ukhuluma ngokudla, hhayi ngokudla ndawonye.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.o.c: Naye ucabanga ukuthi i-비빔밥 ibabayo kakhulu.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.r.c: 서윤 usho kuphela ukuthi akakwazi ukudla ukudla okubabayo. 하준 uphendula lowo mugqa futhi akasho lutho ngo-비빔밥 lapha.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.o.d: Naye akakwazi ukudla ukudla okubabayo, njengo-서윤.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.explain: U-'-도' (futhi) uxhuma lokho okushiwo manje nalokho okushiwo ngaphambilini. Umugqa ongaphambi ngqo kwewa-하준 uwa-서윤: akakwazi ukudla ukudla okubabayo. Ngakho nokuthi 하준 akakwazi nakho. Imigqa emibili ngaphambili wathi uyayithanda i-비빔밥, ngakho kumele acabange ukuthi i-비빔밥 ingaba ethambile.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.prompt: Bonke abangane abathathu bangadla i-비빔밥 ndawonye? Khetha ZONKE izinto okufanele uzithole ngaphambi kokuphendula.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.hint.0: Yenza uhlu lwalokho umuntu ngamunye akushilo, bese umaka lokho okusalahlekile ngamunye.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.hint.1: Susa amaqiniso angeke ashintshe impendulo, noma ayini.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.o.a: Ukuthi isitolo singayenza yini i-비빔밥 engabababi
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.o.b: Ukuthi 하준 ngempela akakwazi ukudla ukudla okubabayo yini
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.r.b: Usanda kusho kanjalo nge-저도요, ngakho usuvele uyazi.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.o.c: Ukuthi 지아 wadla i-비빔밥 izolo yini
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.r.c: Lokho 지아 akudle izolo akunquli ukuthi laba abathathu bangadlani namuhla.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.o.d: Ukuthi 서윤 uzimisele ukudla i-비빔밥 uma ingabababi yini
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.o.e: Ukuthi 지아 uyakuthanda ukudla okubabayo yini
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.r.e: 지아 ufuna i-비빔밥 noma kunjani; ukunambitheka kwakhe kokubabayo akuvimbi abanye ukuyidla.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.explain: Izinto ezimbili zivulekile. Ukudla kumele kube nokwenzeka ngaphandle kokubabayo, futhi 서윤 usho kuphela lokho angakwazi ukukudla, hhayi lokho akufunayo. Amanye amaqiniso awashintshi impendulo.
n-k-k3-05.s.s3.prompt: Bhala umbuzo engxoxweni yeqembu ngesiKorea (inkulumo enenhlonipho) othola iqiniso elilodwa elilahlekile. Unganquma nje kubo.
n-k-k3-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Impendulo inganginiza elilodwa lamaqiniso amabili alahlekile?
n-k-k3-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Umbuzo wami unenhlonipho futhi ulula ukuphendula ngomusho owodwa omfushane?
